entries.what: Rochelle drops DeShawn at Flats High, then walks the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk for her back before settling at the kitchen table with index cards.
entries.outcome: Finished the muscular system cards before lunch.

entries.what: Keisha calls at 10 a.m. from her first week in the AFUSD transportation dispatch office, chatting about the new job and nagging Rochelle about studying.
entries.outcome: Call ran 15 minutes; Keisha said she would call again tomorrow.

entries.what: Rochelle goes to Intro Chemistry-prep reading and packs Andre's two sandwiches and thermos for his 6 a.m. yard shift the next day.
entries.outcome: Lunches prepped and the calendar updated with color pens.

entries.what: Morning chemistry class at 11 a.m., then Rochelle drives her mother-in-law Loretta to the pharmacy and checkup at 3:30, which means skipping Pedro's Tuesday study group with Gus.
entries.outcome: Missed the 4 p.m. group; Loretta's errands ran long.

entries.what: That evening Rochelle asks for a quick anatomy summary of what the study group covered, since she skipped it for Loretta Tuesdays.
entries.outcome: Got a short summary and copied it onto cards after 9 p.m.

entries.what: Keisha calls again on her dispatch break and Rochelle takes it while making Loretta's pharmacy pickup list.
entries.outcome: Keisha scolded her about study time, then hung up fast.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m. with Dr. Okoye, sitting next to Linh, followed by the Wednesday lab.
entries.outcome: Lab ran long and her back flared from sitting.

entries.what: Rochelle eats leftovers from her blue cooler bag in the car in Lot C, then stops at Okoye's 1 p.m. office hours to ask about the quiz format.
entries.outcome: Got clear answers on what the first quiz block covers.

entries.what: Evening at home: dinner with Andre and DeShawn, then laundry folding with her hospital drama on.
entries.outcome: Went to bed early.

entries.what: Intro Chemistry at 11 a.m., then Rochelle studies the kidney and asks if a nephron is basically a sort line with rejects going back on the belt.
entries.outcome: The analogy held up well enough that she wrote it on her cards.

entries.what: Luisa sends warehouse gossip in voice notes at 11:30 about the peak-season hiring and the new cold dock rules.
entries.outcome: Rochelle listened in the car and sent back a laughing reply.

entries.what: Pick-up and dinner prep for DeShawn, with a grocery run to Ruiz Family Market for chicken.
entries.outcome: Spent under budget and wrote it on the calendar.

entries.what: Rochelle registers for the 1-unit online medical terminology course after Denny's map showed it fits her plan.
entries.outcome: Added to her schedule; her course load now includes it.
entries.feeling: committed, a bit nervous about the online part

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m., then lunch in Lot C and a long study block at the college library.
entries.outcome: Finished the week's cards.

entries.what: Evening with Andre and Aaliyah, who talks about the hiring fair at Ridgeline tomorrow.
entries.outcome: Aaliyah planned to go early.

entries.what: Rochelle goes with Aaliyah to the Ridgeline peak-season hiring fair at the community center, recognizing old coworkers in line.
entries.outcome: Aaliyah was hired as a seasonal picker at $21.75.
entries.feeling: proud, strange being on that side

entries.what: Afterward Rochelle stops at Panadería-adjacent errands and Ruiz Market for the week's meat before home chores.
entries.outcome: Errands done by 2 p.m.

entries.what: Evening at home, she talks with Andre about Aaliyah's new job over dinner.
entries.outcome: Everyone agreed to sort out rides next week.

entries.what: Rochelle does Sunday batch cooking of red beans and rice, skipping church to catch up on errands.
entries.outcome: A week of lunches packed.

entries.what: Andre watches football and falls asleep by the second half while Rochelle works through chemistry problems at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Finished the problem set.

entries.what: She writes the coming week on the fridge calendar with color pens, including the new online terminology course.
entries.outcome: Week mapped out.
